description:
Hosted-tool execution layer, extracted from
        core so the pipeline module stays a pure through-pipe. Contains:
        - The hosted-tool SPI (HostedToolHandler, HostedToolRepository
          with the getOrder() precedence contract, HostedToolHandlerFactory,
          HostedToolResolution, OrchestratableTool)
        - The multi-pass hosted execution loop (HostedToolExecutor,
          pass lifecycle policies, output augmenter)

        Engine and SPI only: no repository implementation and no tool lives
        here. The local registration site (LocalHostedToolRepository) ships
        in franca-tools-local; the MCP repository in
        franca-tools-mcp; the FC function-library repository in
        franca-tools-alibaba-fc. Programmatic Tool Calling is owned by
        the orchestration entry resolved from a repository — there is no
        orchestration provider axis in this module.

        Depends on IR (typed requests/events, mapper) — but NOT on the
        pipeline, any adapter or driver, any tool module, or Spring. The
        pipeline consumes this module through one optional collaborator
        (HostedToolExecutor); a deployment that never declares a hosted
        tool never runs any of this code.
